title: Plastic bottle planter
description: Turn a clean, empty plastic bottle into a small planter.
materials_needed: PET bottle; scissors; soil; small plant
instructions: Clean and dry the bottle. Carefully cut an opening, make drainage holes, add soil and plant a small seedling.
safety_warnings: Use scissors carefully. Smooth or cover sharp cut edges.

title: Cardboard desk organiser
description: Reuse a cardboard box to organise stationery and small items.
materials_needed: Cardboard; glue; ruler; scissors; decorative paper
instructions: Measure and cut the cardboard into panels. Assemble compartments, secure them with glue and allow them to dry.
safety_warnings: Use a cutting tool carefully and keep the organiser dry.

title: Tin-can pencil holder
description: Convert a clean tin can into a stationery holder.
materials_needed: Empty tin can; paper; glue; paint
instructions: Clean the can. Make sure no sharp edges remain. Cover or decorate the outside and use it to store stationery.
safety_warnings: Sharp metal edges can cause serious cuts. Do not use cans with exposed sharp rims.

title: Decorative glass bottle vase
description: Reuse a suitable glass bottle as a decorative vase.
materials_needed: Glass bottle; paint; brush; decorative string
instructions: Wash and dry the bottle. Decorate its exterior with paint or string. Allow it to dry before use.
safety_warnings: Do not cut or drill glass. Reject cracked or chipped bottles.

title: Handmade recycled paper
description: Turn clean waste paper into handmade sheets for craft projects.
materials_needed: Used paper; water; basin; mesh screen; sponge
instructions: Tear clean paper into small pieces. Soak and pulp it with water. Spread the pulp over a mesh screen, remove excess water and allow the sheet to dry.
safety_warnings: Use clean, non-contaminated paper. Avoid glossy, wax-coated or chemically contaminated paper.
